items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I played with Benny Goodman's orchestra about a year and a half

ctx.x: He played bass, he played piano, he sang and everything.

And later on when I was in Honolulu with Benny Goodman, well he had a television show, him and his wife. But any way, '41 we went back to California, and this time we went out there and we made some V disk -- no, I mean that's with Billy Eckstein -- I mean with Earl Hines. We went back to California. It wasn't quite as bad this time, and we had a pretty good little tour and then we came back and then

that was in the latter part of '41. And in '42 we toured all over until finally in December of '42 when I had this little confrontation with Earl about salary and everything, and he said he couldn't pay me, I says okay, if you can't pay me I'm leaving the band. So he said, well I can't pay you, B, I said okay, I said then you'll have to get somebody else, I'm leaving tonight. I'm going through Dallas and seeing my mother and then I'm going on back to New York because by this time my son had been born in September…
